invariants.rationale: If drawable is not null, drawable.draw(batch, x, y, width, height) was called; this likely requires batch to be non-null.
draw is called only if drawable != null, and it is likely that width must be non-negative for meaningful rendering.
Similarly, draw is only called if drawable != null, so height should be non-negative when drawable is non-null.
If draw is called, the rectangle's right endpoint should be at least as great as the left (non-negative width assumption).
If draw is called, the rectangle's top endpoint should be at least as great as the bottom (non-negative height assumption).
